name: Kimi to Yumemishi
source:
Ever since an accident when he was a child, Kimito has been able to peep into the dreams of others. While his ability enabled him to see a person’s true self, he often became entangled in their nightmares as well. Gradually, he came to unconsciously avoid being too close with others.

Instead of helping others, he would rather pass his time peeping into girls’ unladylike dreams. He targeted the comprehensive school Shuuei Gakuen, which included a large hospital and an university. Not only would there be girls around his age, but he could also snoop in the dreams of sexually-frustrated nurses!

However, there he met four girls with wishes that they couldn’t tell others due to varying circumstances. He decided to enroll in the school to truly understand them. Before he knew it, he fell in love with one of them. For the first time, he felt a strong desire to help someone else.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/07/28/july-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
自从童年时发生事故以来，公人就能窥探他人的梦境。这个能力让他看见一个人的真实自我，却也经常让他卷入噩梦。渐渐地，他开始无意识地避免与别人走得太近。

与其帮助他人，他更愿意把时间花在窥探女孩不淑女的梦上。他的目标是修英学园，这是一所设有大型医院与大学的综合学校。不仅能遇到同龄女孩，还能窥探性欲不满的护士们的梦！

然而，在那里，他遇见了四名因各种原因无法向他人诉说愿望的女孩。他决定入学，真正理解她们。不知不觉间，他爱上其中一人，也第一次产生了强烈帮助他人的愿望。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/07/28/july-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
